entities.name: Q8UGL3
observations: Exact sequence match (100% identity and full coverage) to reviewed Agrobacterium fabrum 4-hydroxy-tetrahydrodipicolinate synthase.
Assigned to lysine biosynthesis via the diaminopimelate pathway; annotated cytoplasmic and homotetrameric.
Sequence length 294 aa; calculated molecular mass 31,132 Da, theoretical pI 6.15; DHDPS Pfam PF00701.29 spans residues 2–288.

entities.name: Lysine DAP pathway
observations: DHDPS catalyzes a step in L-lysine biosynthesis via the diaminopimelate pathway.
